# Josephine Barry

[Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood)

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is a thin, prim, and rigid old woman with wrinkled cheeks. She wears gold-rimmed glasses, through which her sharp black eyes snap and twinkle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

A critical and rather selfish older woman, Miss Josephine Barry historically cared little for anyone other than herself. Despite these traits, she is known to be a most hospitable lady.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## History

Josephine Barry, an aunt who resided in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), was unexpectedly jumped on by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) while sleeping in a spare-room bed during a visit to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Though initially furious, she was won over when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally apologized and defended [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), prompting Miss Barry to forgive the girls and extend her stay. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her mansion for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), enjoying Anne's company before sending them home. During Anne's time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Miss Barry frequently hosted her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and later attended her commencement ceremony.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## Quotes

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped on top of her in a spare-room bed, sparking intense anger. However, Anne's honest and dramatic personal apology won Josephine over, prompting her to forgive the incident and stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two formed a warm friendship, with Josephine hosting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a trip to the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) at her town mansion and later expressing great pride in Anne's achievements at Commencement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P27](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P48](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0048), +15 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is the aunt of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She includes [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in social outings, such as inviting her and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay at her town mansion to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). Their dynamic also involves Josephine's temper, as seen when she briefly threatened to cut off Diana's music lessons after being disturbed in the spare-room bed.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
